description:
Durable-execution persistence/resume for Weavric (#143/#27). Captures a run's
        snapshot when a block suspends (delay / waitForTrigger) and rehydrates it later when its resume
        condition is met, behind a swappable ISuspendedRunStore SPI. Ships an in-memory default impl (with
        atomic CAS claim) and an optional JPA-backed impl activated only when JPA is on the classpath.
